entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Yeah, I need to make a return. Just connect me to someone.
Thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Isaac. How can I—
I need to return an item. Order number is VF-886-1209-B. Can I do it or not?
Okay, one moment while I pull that up... I see an order for the VeloPro cycling shoes, delivered on December 1st. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with them?
They don't fit. I've tried everything, adjusted the cleats, but they keep giving me terrible blisters after every ride. I just want a refund.
I'm sorry to hear about the blisters; that sounds very uncomfortable. I can definitely check on the return eligibility for you. Let me just confirm our policy.
Okay, I've checked it. Our policy for standard items like these cycling shoes is a 90-day return window. Your order was delivered 48 days ago, so you are well within the timeframe for a return.
Good. So you're processing the refund?

Yes, absolutely. I've just authorized the return in our system. I'm sending you an email right now with a pre-paid shipping label. Just package the shoes up, attach the label, and drop them off. Once we receive them, we'll process your full refund.
Okay, the email just came through. That's all I needed. Thanks.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day.
